title: EnvironmentNoticeType

anyOf.description: Startup finished.
A new harness version now runs.
New runs are refused before a restart.
An update waits for idle, the cap or a request.
An update began its drain.
An update did not take, and the version it went from runs.
A pending update was withdrawn.
A check of the release channel changed the newest or the last check updates.status shows; a client reads it again.
The environment was renamed; a client redraws its badge.
The environment took another icon; a client redraws its badge.
The environment took another colour; a client redraws its badge.
The union of the other environments client sessions report changed; a client reads instructions.list and instructions.preview again.
An account changed; a client refreshes what it caches of the accounts.
The sign-in changed state: the verification URL, the end.
Which executable sign-ins run, recorded once.
A run waits for a person's answer.
A parked prompt was answered.
An account's plan-usage reading changed; a client refreshes what it caches of the readings.
The denylist changed; a client reads permissions.denylist.get and permissions.settings.get again.
The Unattended review changed; a client reads permissions.review.list again.
A forge account was added; a client refreshes what it caches of the forge accounts.
A forge account's slug, aliases or credential changed; a client refreshes what it caches of the forge accounts.
A forge account became the primary forge; a client refreshes what it caches of the forge accounts.
A verification of a forge account found something changed; a client refreshes what it caches of the forge accounts.
An operation showed whether a forge account can do something; a client refreshes what it caches of the forge accounts.
git refused a forge account's credential; a client refreshes what it caches of the forge accounts.
A forge account was removed; a client refreshes what it caches of the forge accounts.
A harness operation was refused on an origin no forge account covers; a client refreshes what it caches of the forge accounts.
A bank was registered, created or joined; a client refreshes what it caches of the banks.
A validated bank change was held for review as an immutable snapshot.
A session queued a validated draft or retirement; clients refresh banks.drafts.list.
A landing consumed its queue snapshot; clients refresh banks.drafts.list.
A bank's registry settings, sync status or what its BANK.md names changed; a client refreshes what it caches of the banks.
A session pinned or unpinned a folder of a bank.
A bank left the registry; a client refreshes what it caches of the banks.
A sync moved a bank's checkout to a new head; a client refreshes what it caches of the banks.
A verification found a bank's status changed; a client refreshes what it caches of the banks.
Drafts landed on a bank's main; a client refreshes what it caches of the banks.
A landing on a bank failed; a client refreshes what it caches of the banks.
A landing on a bank waits for an owner's review in a pull request; no bank's record changes.
A key-manager connection was added; a client refreshes what it caches of the key-manager connections.
A key-manager connection's sign-in ended; a client refreshes what it caches of the key-manager connections.
A key-manager connection was signed out; a client refreshes what it caches of the key-manager connections.
A key-manager connection's label, address, CA or token role changed; a client refreshes what it caches of the key-manager connections.
Which of a key-manager connection's policies runs receive was ticked; a client refreshes what it caches of the key-manager connections.
Where Move keeps the harness's secrets on a key-manager connection was set; a client refreshes what it caches of the key-manager connections.
A key-manager connection became the one of its provider whose variables runs receive; a client refreshes what it caches of the key-manager connections.
A verification of a key-manager connection found something changed; a client refreshes what it caches of the key-manager connections.
A key-manager connection was removed; a client refreshes what it caches of the key-manager connections.
An item's stored value was moved into a key manager.
A stored value a move left behind was deleted; a client refreshes what it caches of the items to move.
An item's stored value was answered once to a client session, to paste at a target the login cannot write.
A routine changed; a client refreshes its routines list.
A routine's result, for every connected client.
A routine's result could not be delivered to its webhook.
A webhook endpoint was made or replaced; a client refreshes what it caches of the webhook endpoints.
A webhook endpoint was removed; a client refreshes what it caches of the webhook endpoints.
Settings changed, with every settings.updated; a client refreshes what it caches of the settings.
Browser origins changed; every client refreshes web.origins.get.
A Set up step's result changed in anything but when it was checked; a client replaces that step's result in what the snapshot's setup gave it.
The skill set changed; a client reads skills.get again.
A trust decision was recorded or revoked; a client reads trust.get and trust.list again.
An owned instruction changed; a client reads instructions.list and instructions.preview again.
The Managed tools registry's notice: a probe, or a latest version fetched, changed rows; a client refreshes what it caches of tools.list.
A tool's install or update began in a tool terminal.
A tool's install or update in a tool terminal ended, with its exit code and verification.
An unpaired extension opened its socket to the listener; the Browser card ticks Load.
Carry over's notice: an import of an adopted account's directory ended, with its counts and what failed; a client reads carryOver.inventory again.
A memory folder no transcript maps was assigned to a repository and copied; a client reads carryOver.inventory again.
A state import ended, with its report and what failed; a client reads stateImport.detect again.
A Workspace directory's check command was set, changed or cleared; a client reads checks.get again for its sessions in that directory.
Clear stale failure-send offers in every Session of this canonical Workspace directory; a check passed or a manual check began.
A worktree stayed, unlocked, when the last session naming it was purged; the client raises a notice naming it and why.
A paired Chrome was paired, renamed or unpaired, connected, disconnected or reported another extension version; a client reads browser.chromes.list and browser.status again.
A call addressed to one client session, which answers it with client.answer before its deadline; every other client leaves it alone.

description: An environment notice's event type, each type described by what it tells a client.
